# Test hasBreak with switch inside loop
mv F:/BEGIN/+0,/END/-0 New
-- x.go --
package p

func F(x int) {
	y := x + 1
	// BEGIN
	for i := 0; i < y; i++ {
		switch i {
		case 0:
			break
		default:
			_ = i
		}
	}
	// END
}
